title: PayNest: A few things from the sprint review

input.subject: A few things from the sprint review
input.message:
Hi all,

Great demo yesterday. Three things from the review:
1) Could P2P transfers have a 'split the bill' option so a user can request money from up to 5 friends at once?
2) The savings pot icon is cropped on small Android phones (Galaxy A14).
3) Users keep asking for a monthly spending report emailed to them. Can we get that in too?

Best,
Olivia
input.source: sample M03 (email from Olivia Grant, Product Owner, PayNest)

check.label: Citation check
check.job: Every verdict must cite SOW clauses that exist and support it; else 'ambiguous'.

estimator.label: Change-Request Estimator
estimator.job: Estimates hours by role for out-of-scope asks from Empower's history.

pricing.label: CR pricing
pricing.job: Change-request price = hours x the SOW's rates + PM overhead.

reply.label: Reply Drafter
reply.job: Drafts the client reply: covered, change request with price, or a question.

guard.label: Leak guard
guard.job: Blocks internal costs, margins or prompt text in the client reply.

items.basis: S1 covers ordinary P2P requests, but requesting from up to five friends at once is new group-request behavior. Sized as a small extension to existing transfers, using the payments benchmark actuals and the similar PayNest mobile project (P105) as context; substantially below a full medium payments module.
assumptions: Existing transfer and risk-engine APIs can be reused; no changes to payment rails or settlement behavior.
Scope is one initiator creating a request for up to five PayNest users, with individual request status; no group chat, reminders, or partial-payment allocation beyond existing request handling.

items.basis: X3 explicitly excludes spending reports and emailed statements beyond the transaction list. Estimated as a limited monthly aggregation and email report for the existing system, scaled well below the reporting benchmark's medium-module actual of 199.3 hours; notification work relies on existing email capability.
assumptions: Report uses transaction data already available in PayNest and a single standard monthly summary/template; no new analytics dashboard or user-configurable report builder.
Existing email delivery service and verified email addresses are available. External email-provider charges, if any, are not included.

data.subject: PayNest project requests
data.body:
Hi PayNest team,

Thanks for sharing these requests.

1. The split-the-bill option for requesting money from up to five friends is outside the signed scope. We can provide it as a change request under the Change Requests clause (C1), estimated at 62.5 hours for GBP 1,550.

2. We’ll fix the cropped savings pot icon on small Android phones as part of the agreed Savings Pots v2 work (S2).

3. A monthly spending report emailed to users is outside the signed scope of Analytics Features (X3). We can provide it as a change request, estimated at 46 hours for GBP 1,180.

Please let us know if you’d like us to proceed with either change request.

[Your name]
Empower Solutions
